name: aeval_pow_two_pow_dvd_aeval_iterate_newtonMap
statement: IsNilpotent (aeval x P)) (h' : IsUnit (aeval x <| derivative P)) (n : ℕ) : (aeval x P) ^ (2 ^ n) ∣ aeval (P.newtonMap^[n] x) P

name: existsUnique_nilpotent_sub_and_aeval_eq_zero
statement: IsNilpotent (aeval x P)) (h' : IsUnit (aeval x <| derivative P)) : ∃! r, IsNilpotent (x - r) ∧ aeval r P = 0
